d18-05.text: We managed to cut the error rate by about sixty percent.
d18-05.turbo: We managed to cut the error rate by about 60%.

d19-06.text: The write path is going to be the bottleneck here, not the reads.

d19-08.text: What happens if one of the nodes goes down in the middle of a write?
d19-08.turbo: What happens if one of the nodes goes down in the middle of a write?

d19-09.text: There's a trade-off here between consistency and availability.
d19-09.turbo: There's a trade-off here between consistency and availability.

d19-10.turbo: If I had more time, I'd look at how we handle failover across regions.

d20-01.turbo: Thanks for the offer, I'm really excited about the role.

d21-07.turbo: Going forward, every config change will need a second pair of eyes.
